classification: Exploratory conditional follow-up, planned after observing the first three native-profile Deluge attempts; not part of the original 36-slot protocol.
decision_rule: After all 36 original slots finish, run this follow-up only if Deluge has fewer than three independently verified completions among its six original attempts.
purpose: Exercise loaded download performance and memory with a working IPv6 listen interface rather than relying on one successful native-profile download.
condition: Same Deluge image, quotas, metadata, fresh daemon/configuration/payload, deadline, discovery settings and network. Set listen_interface to the interface carrying the default outgoing route, enabling native IPv4/IPv6 sockets. Validate sockets in a separate preflight before timed trials.
stopping_rule: Run all six assigned follow-up attempts once; retain every failure; never replace native-profile measurements or select fastest runs.
analysis: Separate condition: every attempt, completion count, conditional median/IQR/range, CPU and sampled memory distributions. Do not pool with the native-profile cohort or claim a contemporaneous head-to-head speed ranking.
retention: One shared scratch ISO; independent SHA-256 outside timer; delete after every attempt; remove project volumes on exit.
